description: Report record verification decay: records ranked oldest-verified first, with per-bucket counts. Use to find matters overdue for re-verification before relying on them.

as_of.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to age records against. When omitted, days_stale is not computed and records are returned sorted by verification date only.

dataset.description: Optional dataset bucket filter, such as included, review, or global.

name: get_staleness_report
